label: AH_PLC_to_PMS
info:
Reads AH PLC kit Modbus (D200–D212 holding + M301–M316 coils) and POSTs merged readings to EAP-PMS machine 8 (SPM_AH_PLC).

Edit node 'cfg PMS target' before Deploy:
  PMS_BASE = http://192.168.1.116:8010
  MACHINE_ID = 8
  DEVICE_NAME = SPM_AH_PLC

Also keeps GET /api/plcdata for local dashboards.

name: cfg PMS target
Format All Parameters
Format Coils M301-M316
Merge + build PMS readings
POST result status
Build plcdata Response
